test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 17 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In July 2025, which scheme was launched to boost agricultural productivity across 100 districts with district-level interventions?

options.text: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana

solution:
The correct answer is __**PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 
• **PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana** was launched in **July 2025** to address district-level agricultural challenges and boost productivity across **100 districts**. 
• The scheme focuses on **local interventions** tailored to the specific agricultural needs of each district, ensuring targeted improvements and sustainability. 
• It aims to promote the use of advanced agricultural technologies, enhance irrigation facilities, and encourage the adoption of sustainable farming practices. 
• The initiative also includes measures for **soil health enhancement**, better access to quality seeds, and reducing post-harvest losses through improved infrastructure.
